summary: All adapters must enforce schema-aware confirmation, and local evidence must retain meaningful fields and typed selection arguments.
reason: Generic JSONL transport cannot safely replay a multiplexed MCP endpoint; heterogeneous compact rows must not discard comparison values, and structured read filters need JSON types.
validated_outcome: Regression fixtures prove raw-import transport is unreachable, rare before/after values survive agent output and JSON array filters reach the read-only tool.
